title: Add release installer documentation contract
description: Document the prebuilt artifact, pinned one-line installation, checksum/provenance verification, runtime prerequisites, update, rollback, and limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md and README_FA.md describe the same commands and supported environments
The documented command is version-pinned and does not tell the VPS to build source
The docs distinguish Node.js/runtime/tunnel binary prerequisites from the application artifact
The docs explain static assets, immutable directories, atomic cutover, backup, and rollback
Examples contain no real secret values

steps.description: Add a check that extracts the documented install command/version and compares it with the release manifest and installer help.
Add the final release workflow, architecture selection, verification, update, rollback, low-resource, and troubleshooting sections while retaining useful existing tunnel documentation.
Mirror the English release contract and commands in Persian, keeping method names and code examples understandable.
Run the documentation check and manually inspect both files for stale source-build claims or contradictory commands.

technicalNotes: Do not claim a self-contained native executable; the selected contract is a prebuilt artifact with Node.js 22 runtime.
